title: Xbox Unveils Alligator-Themed Xbox Series X for GTA 6 Era
description: Xbox has revealed the Series X-BITE, a working Xbox Series X swallowed by a custom alligator, complete with a giveaway for fans.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Xbox Reveals the Series X-BITE Custom Console

As anticipation for *GTA 6* continues to dominate the gaming landscape, hardware manufacturers and brands are finding creative ways to join the conversation. According to a recent report by Polygon, Xbox has unveiled a remarkably unique custom hardware piece: the **Series X-BITE**, a fully functioning Xbox Series X encased inside a custom alligator model.

### A Nod to the Wild Side of Gaming

For fans following the hype around *GTA 6* and its Florida-inspired setting of Vice City, wildlife like alligators has become an unofficial mascot of the game's chaotic environment. Xbox's latest creation leans directly into this theme, presenting a design where the console appears to have been swallowed whole by a realistic and fierce-looking reptile.

Crucially, this is not just a decorative statue. The Series X-BITE houses a working Xbox Series X, meaning the eventual owner will possess both a striking art piece and a fully operational next-generation gaming console capable of playing the latest titles.

### How to Enter the Giveaway

For players looking to add this one-of-a-kind collector's item to their setup, Xbox has launched an official giveaway. As detailed by Polygon, fans can follow the designated instructions provided by Xbox to enter the sweepstakes. While specific regional availability and entry deadlines depend on the official terms, these unique hardware drops always generate massive excitement within the gaming community.

## Editor's Take

Xbox's Series X-BITE is a brilliant piece of marketing that taps directly into the cultural zeitgeist surrounding *GTA 6*'s regional aesthetics. By blending high-end hardware with wild, themed designs, Xbox continues to keep hardware enthusiasm alive and fun while fans eagerly await the next chapter in Rockstar's franchise.
